name: CanFURence
blurb: Eastern Canada's premier furry convention, held annually in Ottawa.
notes: CanFURence 2026 ('MarOwOned') ran August 7-9, 2026, already past the research window; a post-con announcement names next year's theme ('Pawdyssey', set in Ottawa) but exact 2027 dates are still TBA (confirmed via web search of fan listings), so no edition is listed yet.
